not able to pass through all fuel price increases

risk_summary: The disclosure provides substantial operating and financial quantification, but extensive forward-looking disclaimers and recurring management-belief language reduce specificity. Key risks include driver shortages, elevated fuel costs, limited fuel-cost pass-through, higher future tax payments, and liquidity constraints affecting auction-rate investments, although the debt-free balance sheet and strong profitability support a generally stable tone.
